adjudication.rationale: The diff updates `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to be an array and adds collective-team logic in `handleNewBooking` to append additional team members’ destination calendars (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`), and `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now iterates over `event.destinationCalendar`. However, the confirm/payment/editLocation-related paths shown still construct `destinationCalendar` as only `[booking.destinationCalendar]` or `[user.destinationCalendar]` (e.g. `confirm.handler.ts` and `webhook.ts`/`paypal-webhook.ts`), with no logic to include additional collective hosts’ calendars. Given `createAllCalendarEvents` only creates events for entries present in `evt.destinationCalendar`, these flows will only create/update a single calendar event (main host) even for collective multi-host scenarios, so multi-host behavior is inconsistent across lifecycle paths.
